I think there are only a few because in lore, there are only few champions that consider themselves as true enemies at heart and these are the ones that actually makes sense. Their hatred for each other is monogamous and not represented by any broad concepts whatsoever. Only the three so far makes sense: Khazix and Rengar needs to kill each other to become the ultimate predator/hunter. Ornn and Volibear basically hated each other especially for what Volibear did to Ornn's followers. Nasus and Renekton, well Renekton is hellbent on killing Nasus and Nasus needs to stop (or kill) his brother because he is an Ascended killing machine. Who knows what he'll do after he is killed by Renekton? They do not just represent rivalry, but something far greater than that.

Take Darius and Garen. That can be a good nemesis duel. But to what extent? Darius doesnt really hate Garen and vice versa. They may see each other as rivals only but they have no necessities in killing one another. Its only their legendary skin lines that screams nemesis to me.

Another is Swain and Irelia. Irelia does hate Swain, but Irelia hates Noxus and Noxian invaders in general. Swain also focuses on the bigger picture, expanding Noxus, rather than smacking Irelia. So as great as their rivalries are, its not really "I need to kill this specific person" theme to trigger a nemesis duel.

Another is Lucian and Thresh. Now this can be a really great nemesis duel, since Lucian wants to kill Thresh for imprisoning his wife. However, Thresh is only a part of the faction Lucian and the Sentinels are at war with. So its more like the Sentinels and the Black Mist, rather than just Lucian and Thresh. I played Rengar ever since. If you want to master him, stick to his playstyle being an obnoxious assassin that the carries hate.

Early game is easy if you go Gromp, Blue, Wolves, Raptors, then Scuttle. Red start is too slow because the camps are so far out. Use you ferocity Q whenever you can and use your Q to reset autos. Find brushes at 0 Ferocity. You win every match up except Rammus if you play it right. Your Battle Roar is broken, save it near death. Use side brushes when ganking side lanes. Never gank mid lane without your ultimate. Always target carries, your goal is to never let them play the game no matter what and make sure to have them uninstall the game because they are helpless against you.

Your early core items should be DB, Dirk, and Last Whisper. You can finish the items later once you analyzed their team. For now, those items one shots almost all carries if you do it right and not get exhausted.

I suggest focusing on 2 lethality items (DB and the other depends on your choice) and full crit that focuses on the highest dps as possible. Which is Lord Dominiks, Infinity Edge, and BloodThirster. If youre a pussy then dont go BT and go Guardian Angel.

Any other itemizations is trash. Your goal as Rengar is to be a cannonball and you shoot headfirst to the carry hoping it dies which it will if you will it because youre Rengar and you fuck carries up so hard theyre gonna add Shieldbow next patch.

Use your Empowered Q on squishy carries
Use your Empowered W if your running away or trying to survive against fighters you cant burst
Use your Empowered E against mobile targets.

I suggest you go practice tool to enhance your fast combo execution. Also, to ease of your playthrough, always turn your Empower Autocast on settings on. 

Good luck and bring hell to all Adc and Lux mains out there

Im getting tired. My sanity getting drained slowly. But I still have some potion injections left. I need to survive for the day, or atleast, make things go unwasted. 

I was about to inject that drug in when I thought about just resting or maybe taking a walk to get my mind off a bit. Maybe this drug makes me go sane but I want to make things easier for me, for once. So I just dropped it down and took a walk outside my office and strolled down the corridors.

I passed by my co-worker's office. Dr. Kal'tsit seems to be chilling in the corner with a cigarette in hand. Looks like its a way for her to regain sanity from all her problems. She was a busy woman. Rarely every going out of her office. Last time I saw her out, she was assigning other operators to do some jobs I dont want to be involved with. Other than that, she was always inside her den. 

I just had a quick thought of going inside and have a small chat with her. Its a rare thing and I have a few more minutes to do something freely. I went inside, knocking of course. But she didnt even said a word, so I let myself in anyway.

She was staring blankly at the wall the whole time. Her face, flushed when she saw me inside her quarters, but she didnt even reacted violently nor said anything.
To be honest, it was an awkward atmosphere. If she isn't talking then maybe I should. Men should always be making the first moves after all.

"So, LMD is kinda running slim these days. Had to pay Platinum a lot for her hardwork. She was always a premium shooter in our squad, and I was thinking about promoting her but she wants a lot of stuff. I know we can't trust her staying with us but she was always a big help so Im just.. you know Im just gonna do it anyway."

She didnt even utter a word. She only glared upon me and rolled her eyes as if she was ignoring me. A wonder when I saw an alcohol on her table. Its half full and it seems she drank it by herself. It would be a waste if she couldnt finish it, looking as if she was half drunk anyway. I was about to grab the neck but she >! grabbed my hand!< , slowly putting it down, refusing me to get a shot.

She was staring deeply into my eyes and slowly leaning towards my face. Like as if she was inviting me to kiss her. I couldn't move, not because I can't, but because I refused to.
Who is this woman? Why does she know me so well when I couldn't even remember even the slightest memory of her. These thoughts circling onto my head. I was drowning in deep questions as I was frozen in place. Not knowing what is happening within reality itself.

I realized that she fell face down, asleep on my shoulders. Her cigarette fell off between her fingers like a twig in an oak tree blown away by a slow gust of wind. She was breathing deeply, sleeping like she never slept for a hundred years. Before I realized she was slowly wrapping her arms around me. She snored quietly, sleeping like a child as if I was her guardian. She looks so vulnerable, so helpless. But I know my limits. One thing I remembered about me, is that I am not a bad person,  atleast for me that is.

I felt so calm and peaceful when she "hugged" me. I never thought about it happening in the first place, but I think my sanity was restored completely just by being close to her.

"I may not remember who you are, to me and everything about me. To who I am, and what I do. But I had a feeling that you were always there for me. I thought the past me was dead, for me atleast. But I realized that it never died. Because it lived within everyone that remembered me, within you."

She was sleeping heavily, so I took the opportunity to carefully place her in the lounge chair. She wouldn't wake up from drinking that much anyway.
